g.text: The Minimum Is the Whole Trick
How a Count-Min Sketch estimates one visitor's frequency without a counter per visitor
The sketch: d rows x w columns of counters (d=4, w=8 shown here; real sizing is closer to d=5, w=2,719)
12 and 9 are inflated by unrelated visitors colliding in those rows --
5 survives as the minimum, the closest estimate to V7's true count.
d x w counters, total -- never one per visitor.
The minimum cancels collision noise; the heap keeps only the K biggest seen so far.
